text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager: on-call SRE Marco Rivera — Severity P1 — Aurelia Financial (dedicated VPC) reporting high error rate + potential PII exposure in dedicated pool aurora-pool-11. Incident link: https://redwood.internal/incidents/INC-2026-045

Marco Rivera: Taking this now. brief impact summary?

Jacob Morris: Customer alerted via support channel at 09:02Z — they found unredacted SSNs in debug request payloads that landed in our logs. Customer is an enterprise VPC tenant (Aurelia Financial). They want immediate redaction and a statement for their privacy/legal team. Sample snippet attached in support ticket.

Elena Gomez: Confirmed sample looked like 9-digit SSNs in cleartext inside request.body.debugInfo. Looks like their app flip enabled debug logging.

Priya Patel: This is sensitive. Escalating to Legal. Do NOT export any raw logs outside our secure channels. We need an access approval before SRE queries indices.

Marco Rivera: quick triage: metrics show spike in indexing errors around 08:58Z after a mapping change rollout to aurora-pool-11. Our redaction pipeline depends on a mapping field (payload.v2) — if mapping changed, redaction rules were skipped.

Alice Chen: Action plan (short):
1) Pause ingestion for tenant aurora-pool-11 to stop new unredacted data.
2) Isolate current indices containing unredacted data and mark them read-only.
3) Start a targeted redaction pass that masks SSNs and other PII, then rebuild search index.
4) Legal to approve controlled SRE access to perform steps 2-3.

Marco Rivera: Executing step 1 -> pausing pipeline now:
```bash
# pause ingestion for tenant
redwoodctl ingestion pause --tenant aurora-pool-11
# verify
redwoodctl ingestion status --tenant aurora-pool-11
```

incident-bot: Ingestion pause request accepted by ingestion-service (request id rwd-39402).

Priya Patel: Sanjay (Legal) — please respond with approval scope. We need ephemeral elevation for SRE to read aurora-logs-* indices and run scrub job. Access must be fully auditable.

Sanjay Reddy: Approved: grant read and write to indices matching aurora-logs-* for the SRE group (marco/alice) for 60 minutes. All actions logged to audit.kms and a copy sent to legal@redwood. No raw exports permitted. If Aurelia requests raw copies, redirect to legal and log the request.

Marco Rivera: Got approval. Granting access and starting scrub job.
```bash
# grant is handled by infra-iam via api
infra-iam grant --principals marco,alice --indices "aurora-logs-*" --ttl 3600 --reason "PII redaction for INC-2026-045"
# run scrub script (pattern match + mask)
./scripts/scrub_logs.sh --tenant aurora --pattern "(\\b\\d{3}-?\\d{2}-?\\d{4}\\b)" --mask "hash"
```

Alice Chen: I'll watch the job. Scrub job will create new indices with suffix -scrubbed and set the original indices to quarantine/retention-hold. Do not delete originals until Legal signs off.

Jacob Morris: I informed Aurelia CS contact (Emily H.) that we're performing a redaction pass and will provide hashed copies plus an audit log. They asked if we can also provide a timeboxed access log for their auditors.

Sanjay Reddy: Legal direction: provide hashed copies and a full audit trail (who accessed, when, commands executed). If the customer insists on raw data, we will require a formal legal request from their counsel and internal CISO approval.

Elena Gomez: Customer SOC confirmed they prefer hashed copies for now. ETA request: how long until we can confirm redaction complete and provide sample verification?

Marco Rivera: Running scrub now — initial pass estimated ~35m for the affected shard set. Then reindexing and verify ~20m. So ~55-60m total if no blockers. I'll post checkpoints.

incident-bot: Status update: scrub job started by Marco Rivera at 1768005620 (job id scrub-7721).

Priya Patel: Reminder: keep debug logs off for that tenant once we finish. Recommend a tenant config guard to prevent debug=true in production by default. I'll open a follow-up ticket.

Alice Chen: Patch prepared to reject debug=true in production config for VPC tenants; will push to staging after incident.

Marco Rivera: scrub completed for first shard set. doing verification against sample sequences.

Marco Rivera: verification: sample lines no longer contain SSNs; hashes present in place. Posting verification snippet to secure channel (redacted here). Continuing with remaining shards.

incident-bot: Update: 50% shards scrubbed (scrub-7721). ETA adjusted to ~30m remaining.

Jacob Morris: Customer asked for a succinct statement for their legal team. Draft offered: "Redwood performed targeted redaction of tenant logs; PII was masked using deterministic hashing; originals quarantined; access logged and provided to Aurelia under audit." Can Legal approve wording?

Sanjay Reddy: That wording is acceptable as interim statement. Legal will prepare official letter once we confirm completion and audits are attached.

Marco Rivera: All shards scrubbed and reindexed. Post-scrub checks passed. I also patched the redaction pipeline to account for the mapping variant that caused the skip. Deploying fix to production for ingestion service now (will be canary then global).

incident-bot: Deploy started by Alice Chen at 1768008720 (deploy id deploy-redact-fix-19). Canary progress: 1/5 pools.

Alice Chen: Canary looks clean. Rolling to remaining clusters.

Marco Rivera: Final verification done — sampled 2000 records across indices, no visible SSN patterns. Marking incident remediation complete from SRE side.

Priya Patel: Security: will run additional regression checks and schedule a follow-up postmortem with redaction failure root cause and safeguards.

Jacob Morris: I sent the interim statement and hashed sample to Aurelia; they acknowledged receipt and thanked us for rapid handling. They requested confirmation of retention policy for quarantined originals.

Sanjay Reddy: Legal: originals remain quarantined under legal hold until further notice. We'll coordinate with Aurelia counsel if they request raw copies; otherwise originals retained per retention policy and subject to legal review.

Marco Rivera: On-call handoff: I'm primary for next 30 minutes, then Alice will take over until end of shift. Priya backup for security.

incident-bot: Incident INC-2026-045 severity reduced to P2 at 1768009000. Monitoring for anomalies.

Marco Rivera: Closing note: scrub script, IAM grant, and deploy logs are in the audit bundle (path: s3://redwood-audit/INC-2026-045). Legal and CS have access. If anyone needs the sanitized sample for their teams, pull from secure channel only.

Alice Chen: Thanks team. Filing follow-up tickets: RDW-1234 (prevent debug in VPC prod), RDW-1235 (redaction mapping robustness), RDW-1236 (postmortem).

Jacob Morris: I'll schedule a customer call tomorrow with Aurelia to walk through timeline and next steps.

Sanjay Reddy: Good job. Keep all communications through approved channels.

Marco Rivera: Incident remediated; moving to monitoring.

incident-bot: Incident INC-2026-045 moved to resolved at 1768009123 by Marco Rivera.
